consentModal.title: Privacy & Cookie Consent
consentModal.description: We use cookies and similar technologies for analytics. Under India's DPDP Act, we need your consent before collecting any data. You can change your preferences at any time.

matomo.title: Analytics (Matomo)
matomo.description: Helps us understand how visitors use our website. Data is stored on our own servers in India. No data is shared with third parties.
